headline: Result Update

highlights: 09 November 2026 CMP*: ₹1,370/- Sector – Pharmaceutical Dr Reddy's Laboratories Ltd. – Q2FY27 1 Result Update Q2FY27 Dr Reddy's Laboratories Ltd • The company reported a 1.5% YoY decline in revenue to ₹8,671crs in Q2FY27, while revenue grew 7% QoQ, supported by recovery in the underlying base business.
The decline in reported revenue was mainly due to lower lenalidomide sales in North America.

However, excluding lenalidomide, the company continued to deliver double-digit growth in its underlying business. • Gross margin declined to 52.1% from 54.7% in Q2FY26, primarily due to lower lenalidomide sales and an unfavourable product mix.
EBITDA declined 24% YoY to ₹1,783crs, with the margin contracting to 20.6% from 26.7% in Q2FY26.
valuation: Management expects gross margins to remain in the 50–55% range over the coming quarters and EBITDA margins to stay above 20%, with a long-term target of 25%.

Validation of the finished product remains pending. o Management expressed confidence in the relaunch, supported by orders already received. o The company continues to target 6–7 million pens in the current year (FY27).

The company remains confident of maintaining EBITDA margins above 20%, with a long-term target of 25%. • North America: Management expects the business to sustain its current growth trajectory, supported by new product launches, semaglutide and complex generics.
watch: Management highlighted complex generics and the planned semaglutide relaunch as key growth drivers going forward. • India: Revenue grew 17% YoY & 8% QoQ to ₹1,851crs, continuing to outperform the Indian Pharmaceutical Market (IPM).
Key Business & Pipeline Updates • Semaglutide: The company expects to relaunch semaglutide in November 2026, subject to successful validation, following the resolution of API scale-up issues.
